name: Eclipse Mosquitto
description: A lightweight, open-source MQTT broker for IoT and home automation with persistent messaging and WebSocket support.

services.name: mosquitto

files.content:
persistence true
persistence_location /mosquitto/data/
log_dest stdout

listener 1883
protocol mqtt

listener 9001
protocol websockets

allow_anonymous false
password_file /mosquitto/data/passwordfile

entrypoint:
umask 077
password_file=$(mktemp /mosquitto/data/passwordfile.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$password_file"' EXIT
mosquitto_passwd -b -c - "$MQTT_USERNAME" "$MQTT_PASSWORD" > "$password_file"
chown 1883:1883 "$password_file"
chmod 600 "$password_file"
mv -f "$password_file" /mosquitto/data/passwordfile
trap - EXIT
exec /docker-entrypoint.sh /usr/sbin/mosquitto -c /mosquitto/config/mosquitto.conf
